subtitle: BizHawk
_drafted_note: Drafted 2026-08-23 from the world's OWN setup guide and the world's published source. No field is filled in from memory or from what other games on the same console do.
_platform_source: world source: Silvris/Archipelago (branch mm1) worlds/mm1/client.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `system = "NES"`. The guide agrees, producing "A patched `.nes` file".
_display_name_source: the world calls the game "Mega Man", not "Mega Man 1" -- `game = "Mega Man"` in both client.py and rom.py. The games sheet lists it as "Mega Man 1"; the world's spelling is what the server matches on. The catalogue id stays mega_man_1 to sit beside the existing mega_man_2 and mm3.
_ap_world_name_source: world source: Silvris/Archipelago (branch mm1), read 2026-08-23 -- worlds/mm1/client.py `class MegaMan1Client(BizHawkClient)` sets `game = "Mega Man"`, and worlds/mm1/rom.py sets the same on MM1ProcedurePatch
description: The six Robot Masters and their weapons as a multiworld.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game - no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until the RAM map has been MEASURED in-game. Nobody has played this. London warns at launch until it is true.
_requires_source: NES title - the game lives on a cartridge or disc the player owns, and the setup guide tells the player to supply it: An English Mega Man ROM, or the Mega Man Legacy Collection on Steam

rom.description: An English Mega Man ROM, or the Mega Man Legacy Collection on Steam
rom._description_source: setup guide: "An English Mega Man ROM. Alternatively, the Mega Man Legacy Collection on Steam." -- the guide has the player point the patcher at Proteus.exe for the Legacy Collection route.
rom._md5_source: world source: worlds/mm1/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `hash = [MM1LCHASH, MM1NESHASH]` on MM1ProcedurePatch, where `MM1LCHASH = "f26a4de87f10552fde0ab93c3069d24c"` (the Legacy Collection extract) and `MM1NESHASH = "4de82cfceadbf1a5e693b669b1221107"` (the NES dump). ⚠ The same file also defines `PROTEUSHASH = "b69fff40212b80c94f19e786d1efbf61"`; that is the hash of Proteus.exe, NOT of a ROM, and is deliberately left out of this list.
rom._size_note: Not measured. London reads size 0 as 'unknown' and matches on MD5 alone, which is the stronger check.

client.name: Archipelago's BizHawk Client
client._source: SCHEMA rule 1, read from the world itself: worlds/mm1/client.py, 2026-08-23 -- `class MegaMan1Client(BizHawkClient)` with `system = "NES"` and `patch_suffix = ".apmm1"`. The guide agrees: "BizHawk Client". Rule 2 satisfied 2026-08-23: Plugins/Scripts/games/mega_man_1.lua written from the world's source (Silvris/Archipelago branch mm1, commit 759131cc), machine-proven (id diff + boot-garbage gate), NOT played — checks_verified stays false.

apworld._source: catalog/sheet_links.json "APWorld" link for Mega Man 1. The setup guide names no source.

patch._source: world source: worlds/mm1/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- `class MM1ProcedurePatch(APProcedurePatch, APTokenMixin)` with `patch_file_ending = ".apmm1"`. The guide agrees: "Your patch file will have the `.apmm1` file extension."

_patch_extension_source: world source: worlds/mm1/rom.py, read 2026-08-23 -- the file defines no APPatchExtension subclass; MM1ProcedurePatch is APProcedurePatch + APTokenMixin with get_source_data/write_byte/write_bytes, so the generic steps are correct. Only rom.py was read, which is where catalog/SCHEMA.md locates this answer.
